notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken, non-Human white creature.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken, non-Human white creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving the creature persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter on it.
 Repeat.
